shadows.name: flat-shell
shadows.purpose: Shell and lobby hierarchy is tonal and border-led.

motion.name: room-arrive
motion.purpose: Brief room transition; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Current Navigation Item
components.description: Selected room in the persistent casino navigation.
components.css: .ds-nav-current { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid #64583c; background: #22241e; color: #e6d19c; font: 500 13px Outfit, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-nav-current svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-nav-current:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e6d19c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Table Register Entry
components.description: A real API table and wager limit as one keyboard-operable entry.
components.css: .ds-table-entry { width: 100%; min-height: 92px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 36px 1fr auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 15px 10px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #343a32; background: #101311; color: #eee9df; text-align: left; transition: background 160ms ease; } .ds-table-entry:hover { background: #171c18; } .ds-table-entry:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e6d19c; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-table-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 1px solid #535842; color: #cfb77c; } .ds-table-icon svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-table-entry strong, .ds-table-entry small { display: block; } .ds-table-entry small { margin-top: 4px; color: #a7aaa0; } .ds-table-limit { color: #e1dfd4; font: 11px 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; }

components.name: Player Ledger
components.description: Compact account context sourced from local casino state.
components.css: .ds-ledger { display: grid; gap: 5px; padding: 17px 18px; border: 1px solid #51503d; background: #171b18; color: #eee9df; } .ds-ledger small { color: #a7aaa0; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .13em; } .ds-ledger strong { color: #e6d19c; font: 450 32px Outfit, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.04em; } .ds-ledger span { color: #a7aaa0; font-size: 10px; }

components.name: Lobby Table Count
components.description: Small count label attached to the API-fed table registry.

components.name: Retry Action
components.description: Retry an API action or state refresh after a visible error.
components.css: .ds-retry { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #795951; background: #30211f; color: #f0d4ce; font: 500 11px Outfit, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-retry:hover { background: #3a2825; } .ds-retry:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e6d19c; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The interface treats NOIR as a composed private club whose tables are easy to read and enter. A persistent navigation rail and a clear table register provide operational structure; the player ledger and recent rounds carry the real account context next to it. Visual character comes from dark green-black surfaces, fine dividing rules, Outfit's adaptable weights, and sparse brass and emerald accents.

Depth stays tonal and mostly flat. The custom adult hostess illustration is a small authored identity element, while gameplay remains the primary experience. Functional transitions are brief and quiet; the interface stays legible at the minimum desktop window and honors reduced-motion preferences.
keyCharacteristics: API-fed balances, limits, statistics, and history.
Restrained color and flat, finely ruled surfaces.

rules.name: The Real State Rule
rules.body: Use color to clarify actual account, result, or selection state; never imply activity the API has not supplied.

rules.name: The Readable Room Rule
rules.body: Scale expressive titles for the current room; keep operational labels compact but comfortably readable.

dos: Do keep the five existing routes stable: lobby, blackjack, slots, roulette, and history.
Do keep backend state as the source for the player's balance, statistics, limits, and round results.
Do keep icons in the shell and lobby within the authored SVG set.
Do respect `prefers-reduced-motion` and keep transitions short.
donts: Don't invent live-player counts, online activity, recommendations, results, or account metrics.
Don't turn the operating surface into a marketing landing page or decorative KPI dashboard.
Don't use emoji as interface icons.
